evals.prompt: Recommend a Manifest V3 setup for a sidebar extension that opens a side panel when the user clicks the toolbar icon.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the side-panel and manifest references, outlining chrome.sidePanel.setOptions, chrome.action.onClicked, and a minimal MV3 manifest with sidePanel permission.
expectations: Covers the smallest permission set (sidePanel + activeTab where possible)

evals.prompt: My MV3 service worker keeps dying after 30 seconds and losing state. How should I persist data and keep alarms firing?
evals.expected_output: Explains service-worker lifecycle, recommends chrome.storage.local for state, chrome.alarms for scheduled wake-ups, and points at references/performance.md.
expectations: Explains that service workers are event-driven, not persistent

evals.prompt: I'm porting a Tampermonkey userscript to MV3. How do I register user scripts and run them in the USER_SCRIPT world?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/user-scripts.md and explains chrome.userScripts registration, world configuration, and @match patterns.
expectations: Covers chrome.userScripts API and USER_SCRIPT world

evals.prompt: Should I request host_permissions for all sites up front or use optional_host_permissions and prompt later?
evals.expected_output: Recommends optional_host_permissions + chrome.permissions.request on demand, citing references/security.md and the principle of least permission.
expectations: Mentions activeTab as a lighter alternative where applicable

evals.prompt: How do I dynamically inject a content script into a tab after a user gesture without broad host permissions?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/scripting.md, recommends chrome.scripting.executeScript with activeTab, and explains target tab spec.

evals.prompt: What's the right CSP for an MV3 popup that loads no remote code, and why can't I use eval or remote scripts?
evals.expected_output: Explains MV3's strict default CSP, bans on remote code and eval, and points at references/security.md.
expectations: Explains the default restrictive CSP and no-remote-code rule
Notes that all logic must be bundled in the extension package

evals.prompt: Build me a Web Store review checklist before I publish my extension.
evals.expected_output: Surfaces the engineering reference's review checklist: permissions justification, privacy policy, single-purpose, icons, and testing on the chromium channel.
expectations: Surfaces the Chrome Web Store review checklist
Mentions Playwright on the chromium channel with --load-extension

evals.prompt: I need to play audio from a background context but the service worker can't touch the DOM. What's the MV3 pattern?
evals.expected_output: Recommends an offscreen document via chrome.offscreen API, citing references/performance.md.
expectations: Recommends chrome.offscreen document for DOM-dependent work
Explains why service workers cannot use DOM APIs

evals.prompt: My popup flickers when it loads. How do I make it feel fast?
evals.expected_output: Recommends measuring time-to-first-paint, lazy-loading non-critical UI, and caching state in chrome.storage.local, per references/performance.md.
expectations: Recommends lazy loading and chrome.storage.local caching

evals.prompt: Should I use chrome.action or chrome.browserAction in my new MV3 extension?
evals.expected_output: Recommends chrome.action (MV3) and notes chrome.browserAction is deprecated, citing references/manifest.md.
expectations: Notes MV2 deprecation and migration path
